def _high_seat_context():
    """Everything the High Seat page (W1b, 2026-09-26) is made of, read once per request: the
    registry, each project's steward record (home_rows), the ranked rows and the brief
    (home_attention), the session registry, the health report, the Campaign record when it
    exists. No model call, no bridge spawn. Best-effort at every seam."""
    import home_attention as _ha
    import home_rows as _hr
    import high_seat_page as _hsp
    today, now = datetime.now().date(), datetime.now()
    # ONE registry read for the page, partitioned in memory (live · parked · the Campaign)
    try:
        everything = list(_rnd.list_projects(include_archived=True, include_future=True, include_retired=True))
    except Exception:
        everything = []
    entries = [e for e in everything if str(e.get("state") or "active") not in ("archived", "future", "retired")]
    groups = {}
    for e in sorted(entries, key=lambda x: (int(x.get("priority") or 2), str(x.get("name") or "").lower())):
        groups.setdefault(str(e.get("group") or "").strip() or "Ungrouped", []).append(e)
    facts_list = _hr.all_project_facts(entries, today)
    facts = {f["id"]: f for f in facts_list}
    try:
        sessions = _sessreg.list_sessions()
    except Exception:
        sessions = []
    hr = latest_health_report()
    names = {e.get("id"): e.get("name") or "" for e in entries}
    rows = _ha.build_attention(tasks=[], sessions=sessions, health=(hr[0], hr[1]) if hr else None,
                               today=today, now=now, project_names=names, projects=facts_list, limit=12)
    try:   # the Cave's Terminal (2026-10-02): the Terminal seat's engine as the default, the plain terminals open now
        default_cli = _aset.get_default_cli()
    except Exception:
        default_cli = "claude"
    terms_open = sum(1 for r in sessions if r.get("plain") and r.get("status") == _sessreg.STATUS_RUNNING)
    stew = _steward_ui()
    bullets = _ha.brief_bullets(rows, facts_list, today=today, seat_name=stew["high_seat_name"])
    counts = _ha.rail_counts(sessions, rows, folders=len(groups), open_projects=len(entries))
    live, _more = _ha.live_rows(sessions, names)
    parked = [e for e in everything if e.get("state") == "future"]
    try:
        _p, tasks, _i = gather_all()
        tasks_open = sum(1 for x in tasks if not x.get("done"))
    except Exception:
        tasks_open = 0
    # the Campaign: the project whose folder is <workspace>/Campaign (PLAN §3), read once
    campaign, initiatives, seeds, seed_rows = None, [], 0, []
    step_dates, relevance_override = {}, {}
    try:
        camp_dir = Path(_paths.data_dir()).resolve().parent / "Campaign"
        entry = next((e for e in everything
                      if e.get("folder_path") and Path(e["folder_path"]).resolve() == camp_dir), None)
        if entry and (camp_dir / "roadmap.json").is_file():
            from steward_cockpit.steward_campaign import read_map as _read_map
            from steward_cockpit.campaign_parts import resolve_parts as _resolve
            m = _read_map(str(camp_dir))
            # the resolver reads the roadmaps home_rows already read this request
            _cache = {("projection", str(f.get("folder") or "")): f.get("projection")
                      for f in facts_list if f.get("folder") and f.get("projection") is not None}
            resolved = _resolve(m.get("steps") or [], cache=_cache, with_lead=True)   # a project part's lead line feeds the initiative's Status
            initiatives = _hsp.campaign_initiatives(m.get("steps") or [], resolved)
            _loose = _hsp.loose_initiative(m.get("steps") or [], resolved)     # a cockpit seated from the Candidates, in no goal yet (2026-10-02)
            try:   # the Candidates' dates (2026-10-02): each step's first and last event on the Campaign record
                _evs = json.loads((camp_dir / "roadmap.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("roadmap_events") or []
                for _e in _evs:
                    _sid, _at = str(_e.get("step_id") or ""), str(_e.get("at") or "")[:10]
                    if _sid and _at:
                        _a, _b = step_dates.get(_sid, ("", ""))
                        step_dates[_sid] = (_a or _at, max(_b, _at))
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:   # the steward's own relevance scores, when it has written them
                relevance_override = json.loads((camp_dir / ".ecgberht" / "relevance.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
            except Exception:
                relevance_override = {}
            if _loose:
                initiatives.append(_loose)
            campaign = {"pid": entry.get("id"), "name": entry.get("name")}
            try:
                from steward_cockpit.campaign_seeds import read_seeds as _read_seeds
                seed_rows = list(_read_seeds(camp_dir) or [])
                seeds = len(seed_rows)
            except Exception:
                seeds = 0
    except Exception:
        campaign, initiatives, seeds, seed_rows = None, [], 0, []
    # W2 of the steward revision (2026-09-28): THE HEAD is one act — his tiers order the day (the first Tier-1 part
    # that needs him), else the oldest wait with its age; a lower-tier part due today leads only as the marked
    # exception (his answer Q3); what closed since he last opened the page rides in the same sentence, gated on
    # change (the page open is the `page_open` boundary, noted in presence). The rest of the brief folds under it.
    head, overnight, last_open = None, [], None
    working, pickup = _working_pids(entries, sessions), None     # the active set (2026-09-29): read before the head
    try:
        from steward_cockpit import presence as _pres
        last_open = _pres.note_page_open()
    except Exception:
        last_open = None
    try:
        # closures after the real INSTANT of his previous page open, one per project and step (Grok W2)
        overnight = [x for f in facts_list for x in (f.get("closed_recent") or ())
                     if last_open is not None and isinstance(x.get("at"), (int, float)) and x["at"] > float(last_open)]
        head = _ha.head_act(initiatives, facts_list, today=today)
        pickup = _ha.pick_up(initiatives, facts_list, working=working, today=today)
        if head and not head.get("pid") and campaign:
            head["pid"] = str(campaign.get("pid") or "")   # a native Campaign task opens the Campaign's own card
        if head and head.get("pid") and head.get("kind") != "oldest-wait":
            f = facts.get(head["pid"]) if isinstance(facts, dict) else None
            if f and f.get("effort"):
                head["effort"] = str(f["effort"])          # the effort the card reads, named in the sentence
        bullets = [_ha.head_sentence(head, overnight=overnight, pickup=pickup)] + [b for b in bullets if not b.startswith("Nothing is waiting")][:4]
    except Exception:
        head = None
    try:
        prefs_html = render_model_prefs_controls(render_steward_control())
    except Exception:
        prefs_html = ""
    capacity = _capacity_rows()
    week = _hr.week_in_words(today)
    try:
        seats = [(p.get("pid"), p.get("dir") or "") for _g, p in (_hsp.seated(initiatives, "active") + _hsp.seated(initiatives, "deck")) if p.get("kind") in ("project", "effort") and p.get("pid")]
        lights = _project_lights(everything, facts, working, seats=seats)      # W2e: every card's light in his words; W2e-7: a seated card's from its own cockpit
    except Exception:
        lights = {}
    hs_turns, hs_stamp = [], ""
    if campaign:
        try:
            hs_turns, _ = _conversation_turns(str(_campaign_dir()))
            from steward_cockpit.steward_campaign import map_stamp as _map_stamp
            hs_stamp = str(_map_stamp(str(_campaign_dir())))
        except Exception:
            hs_turns, hs_stamp = [], ""
    nudge = lane = resume = None
    resume_from = ""
    if campaign:
        def _derive_nudge(kinds):   # W3: ONE nudge at the page_open boundary, derived from the records; "not now" receipts honoured;
            from steward_cockpit import nudges as _nudges     # a part the head's own sentence leads with is never nudged too
            cdir = str(_campaign_dir())
            return _nudges.derive(initiatives, facts, seed_rows, working, today=today, strip_ages=_strip_ages(everything),
                                  goal_last_at=_goal_last_at(cdir), dismissed=_nudges.read_dismissed(cdir), campaign_pid=str(campaign.get("pid") or ""),
                                  head_lead=((head or {}).get("pid") or "", (head or {}).get("part") or ""), kinds=kinds)
        # one lane per item (John, 2026-10-03): a dated item is the interrupt lane at the top of the board, the panel
        # nudge is the next of the other kinds - a dated item never shows twice
        from steward_cockpit import nudges as _nudges_k
        nudge = _nudge_or_log("high-seat", lambda: _derive_nudge(_nudges_k.NOT_DATED))
        lane = _nudge_or_log("high-seat-lane", lambda: _derive_nudge({"dated"}))
        try:
            resume = _nudges_k.read_resume(str(_campaign_dir()), today=today)
        except Exception:
            resume = None
        try:   # what he is on now, kept as the ready-to-resume note if he opens the lane's item: the active initiatives
            _on = [str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "a part").split(" · ")[0]
                   for g, p in _hsp.seated([i for i in initiatives if i.get("status") not in ("done", "parked")], "active")]
            resume_from = (", ".join(_on[:3]) + (" and %d more" % (len(_on) - 3) if len(_on) > 3 else ""))[:240]
        except Exception:
            resume_from = ""
    return {
        "today": today, "today_str": now.strftime("%A, %B %d, %Y"), "week": week,
        "week_short": week.replace("this week ", ""), "brief_when": now.strftime("%H:%M · %A %d %B"),
        "build": BUILD_ID, "steward": stew, "prefs_html": prefs_html,
        "auth_required": bool(_paths.expected_token()),     # R14: the page shows its login box when a token is required and none is held
        "entries": entries, "groups": groups, "facts": facts, "rows": rows, "bullets": bullets, "head": head, "overnight": overnight,
        "counts": counts, "live": live, "parked": parked, "tasks_open": tasks_open,
        "default_cli": default_cli, "terms_open": terms_open,
        "campaign_step_dates": step_dates, "relevance_override": relevance_override if isinstance(relevance_override, dict) else {},
        "campaign": campaign, "initiatives": initiatives, "seeds": seeds, "seed_rows": seed_rows,
        "capacity": capacity, "working": working, "pickup": pickup,
        # 2026-10-02 (the SLOW samples: the folded list's 25 tiles read sessions and usage on every load): built when he
        # opens it - GET /api/high-seat/projects
        "projects_html": '<p class="ptile-note" id="ptileLoading">the list opens when you press Show all</p>',
        # W2c-2: the dialogue on the High Seat — the Campaign's one conversation log and the record's stamp
        "turns": hs_turns[-40:], "n_turns": len(hs_turns), "goal_names": {i["id"]: i["name"] for i in initiatives}, "stamp": hs_stamp,
        "lights": lights, "nudge": nudge, "lane": lane, "resume": resume, "resume_from": resume_from,
    }
